name: Genie
source:
You will experience the story through the eyes of Jack Mason, the young detective in a small town near the N sea. Facing hardships of being among the shunned colorblind minority - the Squints, he tries his best to focus on the brighter things in life. Winning respect from the true-born Imperials by skill and dedication, Jack plans out his future with his loved one. Yet everything changes, then an eerie murder smashes the tranquil atmosphere in town.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/663600/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将通过杰克·梅森的视角体验故事。他是一名年轻侦探，住在北海附近的小镇。身为遭人排斥的色盲少数群体“Squints”中的一员，他努力把注意力放在生活中更加光明的事物上。杰克凭借能力与投入赢得真正的帝国人尊重，并与心爱之人规划未来。然而，一场诡异的谋杀打破了小镇的宁静，一切都发生了改变。

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/663600/]Steam[/url]]
